Name: Profit Calculator
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: Calculate the profits from growing each crop for an entire season.
Description:
**Profit Calculator** adds a console command to calculate the profits from growing each crop for an entire season.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**
Load your save, then run [font=Courier New]profits_crops[/font] in the console to calculate crop profits. This includes any custom crops you installed, and will take account of your farming level.

You can optionally check for a particular season like [font=Courier New]profits_crops spring[/font].

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

**See also**

*   [Release notes](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ProfitCalculator/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)
